code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The patient shows hypoxemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, mild anemia, and elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, ferritin, D-dimer, INR). There is also mild hypoalbuminemia and hypoproteinemia, with low glucose. These findings suggest acute systemic inflammation or infection, possible bone marrow suppression, and increased risk of bleeding. Clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
